title: The Limits of Willpower
sentences: Most people believe that staying healthy is simply a matter of willpower and self-control.
In fact, research suggests that habits shape our choices far more than conscious effort does.
Someone who works long hours is far less likely to cook a proper meal after a tiring shift.
Admittedly, some individuals do manage to build strong routines despite constant pressure.
Nevertheless, blaming tired, overworked people for their poor habits misses the bigger picture.
Access to affordable healthcare also determines who can act on good advice and who cannot.
A person without paid sick leave will often choose to work through an illness anyway.
On the other hand, wealthier people can rest, recover, and prevent problems before they grow.
Burnout, in particular, rarely comes from laziness but from demands that never seem to ease.
If workplaces valued rest as much as productivity, fewer people would collapse from exhaustion.
Ultimately, health is shaped as much by circumstance as by any single personal decision.
